defs.def: a container made of wood, cardboard, metal, etc. with a flat stiff base and sides and often a lid, used especially for holding solid things 尤用于构成复合词

ex.s: Flowers are everywhere-hanging baskets, window boxes, and planters-just what you imagine in an attractive English market town.
ex.t: 鲜花处处可见——悬挂花篮、窗台花箱和花盆——正是你想象中迷人英国集镇的样子。

ex.s: Then I noticed folk conducting spring cleans dropping boxes of voluminous books on various subjects there.
ex.t: 后来我注意到人们在春季大扫除时往那里放了很多装满各种书籍的大箱子。

ex.s: The original iron boxes with the round roofs first appeared in 1926.
ex.t: 对许多英国人来说，这适用于代表他们国家过去的机构和物品——古老的城堡、宏伟的宅邸……还有红色电话亭。

ex.s: In rural areas, where ambulances can take a relatively long time to arrive, the phone boxes have taken on a lifesaving role.
ex.t: 在农村地区，救护车到达可能需要较长时间，电话亭便承担起了救命的角色。

ex.s: Others also looked at the phone boxes and saw business opportunities.
ex.t: 当地组织可以用1英镑的价格认领它们，并安装除颤仪以备紧急情况使用。

ex.s: He said that one of the boxes generated around $13,500 in revenue a month and cost only about $400 to rent.
ex.t: 他说，其中一个电话亭每月产生约13,500美元的收入，而租金仅需约400美元。

ex.s: Inglis said phone boxes called to mind an age when things were built to last.
ex.t: 英格利斯说，电话亭让人想起一个东西都做得经久耐用的时代。

ex.s: The phone boxes are making a comeback ______.
ex.t: 电话亭正在卷土重来______。

ex.s: Why did the phone boxes begin to go out of service in the 1980s?
ex.t: 满足绿色经济的需求

ex.s: The phone boxes are becoming popular mainly because of ______.
ex.t: 它们输给了新技术。

ex.s: Wang believes traditions should not be sealed in glass boxes at museums.
ex.t: 我发现假期前是鼓励小孩子捐赠不太常用的物品的好时机，而且奏效了。

ex.s: When was the last time you used a telephone box?
ex.t: 你上一次使用电话亭是什么时候？

ex.s: When I do, my box will be full of wonderful things for them."
ex.t: 我那个想象的奶奶的箱子那年春天像魔法一样奏效，后来也是。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: I tried making toy cars with cardboard boxes and constructing buildings from leftover cardboard and bits of wood my father gave me.
ex.t: 我尝试用纸板盒制作玩具车，用父亲给我的剩余纸板和木屑搭建建筑。

defs.def: a box and its contents 一盒，一箱（东西）

ex.s: My mobile phone was inside, but luckily there was a telephone box across the street.
ex.t: 我的手机在屋里，但幸好街对面有个电话亭。

ex.s: The telephone box.
ex.t: •每次双人见面的周进度报告

ex.s: Why did the author use the telephone box in 2006?
ex.t: •至少三次双人-教师见面

ex.s: No one knows exactly what happens within this black box.
ex.t: 没有人确切知道这个黑箱内部发生了什么。

ex.s: Again, a black box.
ex.t: 又是一个黑箱。

ex.s: “Life on Earth is kind of a box of spare parts for the inventor,” he says.
ex.t: 地球上的生命对发明家来说有点像一盒备件，他说。

ex.s: It was ___23___ called Mario, coming to ___24___ us a box containing some tomatoes and a bottle of wine.
ex.t: 他（第23空）叫马里奥，过来（第24空）我们一个装着一些番茄和一瓶葡萄酒的盒子。

ex.s: The color she choose came in a box which had a picture of a woman that hair color looked just perfect.
ex.t: 她选的颜色装在一个盒子里，盒子上有一个女人的图片，那发色看起来恰到好处。

ex.s: In a recent experiment, cockatoos were presented with a box with a nut inside it.
ex.t: 在最近一项实验中，凤头鹦鹉面对一个里面装着坚果的盒子。

ex.s: The clear front of the box had a “keyhole” in a geometric shape, and the birds were given five differently shaped “keys” to choose from.
ex.t: 盒子的透明正面有一个几何形状的"钥匙孔"，鸟儿有五把不同形状的"钥匙"可供选择。

ex.s: How did the cockatoos get the nut from the box in the experiment?
ex.t: 凤头鹦鹉如何在实验中得到坚果？

ex.s: By turning the box around.
ex.t: 把盒子转过来。

ex.s: My imaginary Grandma's Box worked like magic that spring, and later.
ex.t: 有时学生会让我描述里面所有的东西。

ex.s: Then someone said, "Now you can use your Grandma's Box." From then on instead of coming to ask their possessions back, the students would say, "That's okay.
ex.t: 把它放进Gordon的奶奶的箱子里吧。"

ex.s: I loved talking about the imaginary box, not only with my students but also with my own children.
ex.t: 我喜欢谈论那个想象中的盒子，不仅和我的学生，也和我自己的孩子。

ex.s: The maker of the Grandma's Box.
ex.t: C 作者的孙子。

ex.s: They asked to see the Grandma's Box.
ex.t: 他们为Gordon做了礼物。

ex.s: “You know that big box of corn Uncle John sent us?
ex.t: 当Meredith太太听到John的主意时，她也觉得很好。

ex.s: It didn’t take long before they walked through the front door carrying a big box.
ex.t: 没过多久，他们就抱着一个大箱子走进了前门。

ex.s: Dad opened the box and a sweet little dog appeared.
ex.t: 爸爸打开箱子，一只可爱的小狗出现了。

ex.s: Directions: Fill in each blank with a proper word chosen from the box.
ex.t: 说明：从方框中选出适当的词填入每个空格。

ex.s: Fill in each blank with a proper sentence given in the box.
ex.t: 用方框中给出的适当句子填入每个空格。

ex.s: When he went home, he sent Benjamin a box of paint and some brushes.
ex.t: 回家后，他给本杰明寄了一盒颜料和一些画笔。

defs.def: a small area in a theatre or court separated off from where other people sit （剧院中的）包厢；（法庭中的）专席

ex.s: For many British people, that can apply to institutions and objects that represent their country’s past-age-old castles, splendid homes… and red phone boxes.
ex.t: 有时很难放手。

ex.s: As Inglis and, later other businessmen, got to work, repurposed phone boxes began reappearing in cities and villages as people found new uses for them.
ex.t: 他说他听到了保护这些电话亭的呼声，也看到其中一些被列为历史建筑。

ex.s: Sometimes, because a housewarming party happens shortly after a person moves into their new home, people may be asked to help unpack boxes.
ex.t: 有时，因为乔迁派对发生在某人搬进新家后不久，人们可能会被叫去帮忙拆箱。

defs.def: a small shelter used for a particular purpose 小亭；岗亭

ex.s: The last time I used a phone box for its intended purpose was … 2006.
ex.t: 我上一次为打电话而使用电话亭，是……2006年。

defs.def: a small square or rectangle drawn on a page for people to write information in 方框；长方格
只允许右拐的车辆进入交叉路口黄格区。
an area on a sports field that is marked by lines and used for a particular purpose 运动场上以线标出的特定区域
a piece of plastic that a man wears over his sex organs to protect them while he is playing a sport, especially cricket （运动员的）下体护身

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为英国许多街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭在20世纪80年代开始消失，移动电话的兴起把它们大多数送进了废品场。

ex.s: About that time, Tony Inglis’ engineering and transport company got the job to remove phone boxes from the streets and sell them out.
ex.t: 大约那时，托尼·英格利斯工程和运输公司接到了从街道上移除并出售电话亭的工作。

ex.s: He said that he had heard the calls to preserve the boxes and had seen how some of them were listed as historic buildings.
ex.t: 但Inglis最终自己买下了数百个，打算修复后出售。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: A year later, much to my ______58______, this man produced a little box with a ring and proposed to me.
ex.t: 一年后，令我大为（第58空），这个男人拿出一个装着戒指的小盒子向我求婚。

ex.s: LoveFone, a company that advocates repairing cellphones rather than abandoning them, opened a mini workshop in a London phone box in 2016.
ex.t: 倡导修理而非丢弃手机的LoveFone公司，于2016年在伦敦一个电话亭里开了一家迷你工坊。

ex.s: Poppy welcomed them home as usual but when she saw the box, she stopped.
ex.t: 她把鼻子凑上去闻了闻。

defs.def: a small evergreen tree or bush with thick dark leaves, used especially for garden hedges 黄杨（常绿，尤用作花园树篱）
the hard wood of this bush 黄杨木
to fight sb in the sport of boxing （拳击运动）击打（某人）
to put sth in a box 把（某物）装箱（或盒、匣）

ex.s: "I'm going to put it in my Grandma's Box."
ex.t: "那是什么？"他们问。

ex.s: Put it in your Grandma's Box for Gordon."
ex.t: 我喜欢谈论那个想象中的箱子，不仅和我的学生们，还有我自己的孩子。

defs.def: to prevent sb/sth from being able to move by surrounding them with people, vehicles, etc. 围困；拦挡

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再被锁在屋外，可悲的是，我家附近的电话亭将不再能帮我联系到钥匙了。

ex.s: All you need to get started is a box of love.
ex.t: 你开始所需的一切，不过是一盒爱。

ex.s: (Note: A "doggy bag" is a bag or box in which you take unfinished food home from a restaurant.) You see a sign in a supermarket saying "3 for 2".
ex.t: （注：“打包袋”是你在餐厅把没吃完的食物带回家用的袋子或盒子。）你在超市看到“买三付二”的标牌。

ex.s: Use the expressions in the box to help you.
ex.t: 用方框中的表达来帮助你。

ex.s: Use the notes in Activity 1 and the expressions in the box to help you.] (Useful expressions * The hero / heroine of my story is...
ex.t: 用活动1中的笔记和方框中的表达来帮助你。]（有用的表达　* 我故事中的男主/女主是……）

defs.def: to prevent sb from doing what they want by creating unnecessary problems 处境

ex.s: So, if you want to see a show that combines music, singing, drama, poetry and costume design with explosive effect, The Revenge of Prince Zidan ticks all the right boxes!
ex.t: 所以，如果你想看一场将音乐、歌唱、戏剧、诗歌和服装设计与震撼效果相结合的演出，《子丹王子复仇记》绝对符合你的所有期待！
